record.original_question: Welsh conjecture: for binary cyclic codes C_{1,ℓ} of length 2^m−1 with ℓ = 2^t + 3 and m = 2t + 1, prove or disprove that these codes have minimum distance five and the same weight enumerator as the 2-error-correcting BCH code.

evidence.quote: We want to mention the oldest conjecture, the so-called conjecture of Welsh: the codes C1,`, of length 2^m − 1, with ` = 2^t + 3 and m = 2^t + 1 , have minimum distance five; furthermore they have the same weight enumer￾ator as the 2-error-correcting BCH code.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $t \ge 1$ be an integer and set $m = 2t+1$ and $n = 2^m - 1$. Let $\alpha$ be a primitive element of the finite field $\mathbb{F}_{2^m}$. For an integer $\ell$ coprime to $n$, define the binary cyclic code $C_{1,\ell}$ of length $n$ as the cyclic code whose zeros include $\alpha$ and $\alpha^{\ell}$; equivalently, $C_{1,\ell}$ is the binary code of length $n$ consisting of all vectors $(c_0,c_1,\dots,c_{n-1}) \in \mathbb{F}_2^{n}$ such that
$$\sum_{i=0}^{n-1} c_i\, \alpha^{i} = 0 \quad \text{and} \quad \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} c_i\, \alpha^{\ell i} = 0.$$
Take $\ell = 2^{t} + 3$. 

Prove or disprove the following statement: the code $C_{1,\ell}$ has minimum distance $5$, and its weight enumerator is identical to that of the binary $2$-error-correcting BCH code of length $n = 2^{m}-1$ (i.e., the code $C_{1,3}$).
artifact.status_search_result: The statement (often called the Welch conjecture on binary cyclic codes $C_{1,2^t+3}$ of length $2^{2t+1}-1$) is listed among the long-standing open problems on cyclic codes, and recent surveys and papers on minimum distances of related BCH-like and cyclic codes continue to refer to such weight-distribution questions as unsettled. No published proof or counterexample establishing minimum distance 5 and the BCH weight enumerator in full generality could be located.

status_evidence.title: Open problems on cyclic codes (Charpin)
status_evidence.snippet: the oldest conjecture, the so-called conjecture of Welsh: the codes C_{1,ell} ... have minimum distance five; furthermore they have the same weight enumerator as the 2-error-correcting BCH code.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is presented as the oldest still-open conjecture about these binary cyclic codes.

status_evidence.title: On the Minimum Distances of Some Families of BCH Codes
status_evidence.snippet: Determining the true minimum distances of BCH codes is generally very hard; several related conjectures remain open.
status_evidence.claim: Closely related minimum-distance conjectures for cyclic/BCH codes are still listed as open in recent literature.
